titles.romaji: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - ROAD TO THE TOP
titles.english: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Road to the Top
titles.native: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー ROAD TO THE TOP

description:
Narita Top Road aspires to be the best uma musume in the Twinkle Series. Admire Vega struggles to use the tracks to bring closure to a dark secret in her past. T.M. Opera O wishes to make a name for herself after being sidelined from an injury for months. When their paths cross, they will form a rivalry that will take the uma musume racing world by storm.

(Source: Anime News Network)
